summary: Composed the actual B02 period plan into parent material/activity. Current clock/date is qualified against the committed B02 plan via historical_period.read_period_plan/read_material_period; parent reads/options/activity receipts/history carry the current period context. B02 employment holder A is explicitly not applied to the parent; parent wage/currency remain parent-local and no household conversion/double-counting is applied. Current-period source severance makes options held but does not retcon past activity receipts. The old global B02-not-built claim is superseded. Two-period/incremental proof remains held pending an exact current-period API.

parent_activity._period_context reads historical_period.read_period_plan and read_material_period at the actual current S46 clock.
parent_activity.establish_parent_material/commit_parent_circumstances/record_parent_activity bind the current period context into C12 episode/receipt and MATERIAL_ACTIVITY event body.
B02 source/material is not edited or copied; only its public API is consumed.
